request.amount_ada: 500,000,000 ada cap on total Treasury withdrawals during the period; no direct withdrawal amount requested
request.deadline: Period begins at start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027
deliverables: Record DReps' agreement to a 500,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Count all Treasury withdrawals already debited during the period toward the limit
request.what: Agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Epochs 613-713.
The Net Change Limit caps only lovelace removed from the Cardano Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawal governance actions recorded on the ledger.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returns of Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the limit.
The action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposer states that the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 has become practically constrained as its window runs into mid-2027.
The proposer states that increasing the limit to 500,000,000 ada preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals while retaining a fixed fiscal guardrail.
The proposer states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake are sufficient to record agreement to the Net Change Limit under TREASURY-01a.
The proposal references the Enacted Cardano Constitution v2.4 via IPFS as its constitutional basis.
The proposer asserts that nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed limit from applying to the same period.

summary: The document proposes an Info action to replace the prior 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 with a 500,000,000 ada cap, with ledger-debited withdrawals counting cumulatively and no direct authorization of spending.
